research_rationale:
EO 9027 (January 16, 1942, Franklin D. Roosevelt) is a short order read in full in the held Federal Register text (7 FR 363, issue of Tuesday, January 20, 1942, one PDF page). Its only operative command amends Subdivision XL of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules; the amendment is the addition of a third paragraph reading "3. One general counsel.". Part III of EO 9830 (signed February 24, 1947; 12 FR 1259, issue of Tuesday, February 25, 1947) is the sentence "hereby revoked:" followed by a list of orders by number, and its enacting clause reads "effective May 1, 1947:" for all Parts alike. The list includes the row "No. 9027 of January 16, 1942.", so EO 9830 expressly revokes this order, and the order's own text states no period, condition or end date. The held EO 9830 text has no wording that saves or excepts any listed order. The first end is the express revocation, effective May 1, 1947.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"No earlier end is held. The order states no period, date or condition. A search of the held corpus for the number in the form \"Executive Order No. 9027\" found no held text citing it other than itself; EO 9830 names it only in its Part III list, in the form \"No. 9027 of January 16, 1942.\". A search for the phrase \"Subdivision XL of Schedule A\" found it only in this order's own text. No held order revokes, supersedes or rewrites this order before EO 9830. EO 9830 Part II restates Schedule A as a whole with the same May 1, 1947 effective date, so the restatement and the revocation do not differ in date.","independent_command_check":"No independent command survives. The authority recital (section 2 of the Civil Service Act) is not a command, and the order contains no proviso, report duty or delegation apart from the amendment itself.","savings_check":"EO 9830 contains no saving, exception or transition wording for orders in its Part III list: a search of the held EO 9830 text for \"incumbent\", \"now serving\", \"existing appointment\", \"shall continue\", \"remain in\" and \"transition\" found hits only in the issue's table of contents. Appointments made under the amended paragraph before May 1, 1947 are consequences of those appointments, not commands of this order, and no held source shows any continuing effect; this is a disclosed qualification, not a finding.","scope_check":"The order has two inventory rows, the amending lead sentence and the added text, and one operative command, to add the third paragraph to Subdivision XL. Both rows are ended together by the same revocation; no row was amended, extended or revoked separately before then."}

Appointments made under the amended paragraph before May 1, 1947 are consequences of those appointments, not commands of this order, and no held source shows any continuing effect; this is a disclosed qualification, not a finding.

Its only operative command amends Subdivision VIII of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules; the amendment is the addition of a paragraph numbered 30 naming "The Solicitor of the Department of" the Interior. Part III of EO 9830 (signed February 24, 1947; 12 FR 1259, issue of Tuesday, February 25, 1947) is the sentence "hereby revoked:" followed by a list of orders by number, and its enacting clause reads "effective May 1, 1947:" for all Parts alike.
